svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ScacchiForge
svg.desc: The ScacchiForge mark, a stem that forks into two moves with the principal variation in amber, above the name and the line: a chess engine that decides by removing work, and never mistakes a heuristic for a theorem.

g.text: A chess engine that decides by removing work,
and never mistakes a heuristic for a theorem.
